title: Milked down (Video (Standard))
description: Obey without thinking. Thought is taken from you, as you are drugged senseless... but still able to sense and feel. Strapped down on an unknown hospital bed. Milked by a mysterious and beautiful doctor. Starting with an induction, and then the implantation of a sleep trigger. Your breath is then put under the control of a ventilator. I may seem rather cold and intimidating, but I am very good at what I am doing. My face is hidden behind a surgical mask, but my eyes are here to be stared at. I give you a hand job - and then proceed to milk you using some specialized equipment. Why are you here? It's not important that you know. Just listen and relax. Feel the release as your mind falls into oblivion. This script was written and offered by u/SofConMac on GWA.
